findings.text: follow-on: record_picker_hold still declares `docs: Path` but no longer reads it anywhere in its body — the write path is now _hold_path(project) and the payload _write_hold_payload(path.parent, ...) — so the parameter is dead and misleads a caller into thinking the hold location still depends on it. Both call sites (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:870 and :1171) still pass docs=. Removing the parameter is an API change the reviewed node did not own; it should be dropped or documented as unused, not left silent.

item_verdicts.diff: git show --stat 6ab7c925..e313cd4d reads one commit e313cd4d2 over six files: reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py moves the log to crew_home()/picker-holds/<project>/ and stamps each row with its source directory; tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py is the new gate; the three existing reader tests read the crew-home log; and a 38-line evidence fragment is added. No other production module is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py, which records a small inline hold and one over HOLD_PAYLOAD_INLINE_LIMIT so _write_hold_payload writes a payload; it asserts both rows land under the crew-home log (tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py:125), nothing under docs (:130), the payload beside the log (:128), replay_hold rebuilding the large request (:131-134), a legacy docs-side hold replaying from its own directory (:143-147), and a merged reader returning both (:159-171). The manifest records the head arm 48 passed EXIT=0 (gate-head.log) and the base arm 3 failed 45 passed EXIT=1 (negative-control-base.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to write picker hold records under the crew home instead of each project's checkout while keeping legacy holds readable and replayable; reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:205 now returns crew_home()/picker-holds/<project>/picker-holds.jsonl, :321 reads that log and any legacy docs-side log, and :108 resolves a row's payload_ref against the log it was dispatched to.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, changed_paths matching the diff, the gate command with its head result 48 passed EXIT=0 and base arm 3 failed 45 passed EXIT=1, both log paths, and a negative_control_note quoting the [] == ['small','large'] failure; its baseline_suite and after_suite JSON carry the failure ids the record's added-failure pair is derived from.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py, tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py, tests/test_hold_records_its_state.py, tests/test_picker_outcomes.py, tests/test_a_jev_hold_queues_for_the_local_lane.py, and the lane-and-model-routing evidence fragment and figures directory; git show --stat 6ab7c925..e313cd4d lists exactly the source file, the four tests and the fragment, every one inside the declaration and nothing outside it.

justifications.durability: reverting the move reddens the gate: the recorded base arm fails tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py:125 with [] == ['small','large'] because the base writes under docs, and tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py:170 would resolve a legacy row's payload_ref against the crew home instead of the stamped legacy directory and error, so the stamping too is guarded.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's gate is tests/test_a_hold_is_kept_in_the_crew_home.py plus all eight files importing picker.outcomes, run with pytest -n 10; gate-head.log records 48 passed EXIT=0 and negative-control-base.log records 3 failed 45 passed EXIT=1, and the base arm was run in a /tmp scratch tree at the base revision rather than in place, a recorded deviation from the done_when's wording.
justifications.fit: the module follows its own existing idiom — crew_home() is imported from reckon.crew.runs and the log sits beside the picks' crew-home timing log (reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:72) — but record_picker_hold's now-unused docs parameter (reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:230) is left in place.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:246 routes record_picker_hold through _hold_path(project) under crew_home(), so no file is created under docs, and :321 reads both the crew-home and the legacy docs-side log with :108 resolving each row's payload against its stamped origin, so a legacy hold still replays.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no second owner: crew_home() is imported from reckon.crew.runs (the existing owner), _hold_path keeps ownership of the hold location it already had, and the added _read_hold_log/_legacy_hold_path/_row_log_dir are private helpers over the same store; a search of reckon/ for another project-keyed crew-home hold log found only this module.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 6ab7c925..e313cd4d lists reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py, the four tests and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write_paths and nothing else, with the declared figures directory simply unused.
